name: neova
description: Neova, the Advanced SEO Platform: ask your crawls for flags, tickets, alerts and pages of the sites you crawled.

interface.longDescription:
Neova, the Advanced SEO Platform, is a desktop SEO crawler for Mac, Windows, Linux and the browser. It crawls your sites, runs several hundred checks on every page, groups what it finds into tickets by page group, and watches the pages you care about for changes between crawls.

In ChatGPT, Neova answers from the crawls stored in your Neova Online account. Ask which sites you crawled and when, how complete a crawl was, what the checks flagged and on which pages, which tickets are open and what each one asks for, what changed since the last watch crawl, how the pages of a site fall into groups, and why a crawl stopped short. Every answer names its crawl and the date the pages were fetched, so a number is never quoted without its date.

What it reads: your crawls, their pages (URL, status, title, canonical, robots, headings, size, inlinks), the flags of the checks with each check's acceptance line and source, tickets, alert events, page groups, the checks catalogue, your crawl settings and a crawl's diagnosis. It never returns the text of a page beyond its titles, descriptions, headings and anchors, each capped at 500 characters.

What it does not do: it does not crawl. Starting, stopping or deleting a crawl, and changing settings, happen in Neova itself, on your computer or on Neova Online. Neova in ChatGPT only reads. It reaches nothing but your own account: no public website, no third-party service.

You need a Neova Online account. Sign in once from ChatGPT, read what Neova will share, and allow it; you can disconnect at any time from ChatGPT's plugin page.
defaultPrompt: Use Neova to list the sites I crawled and when.
Use Neova to show what the checks flagged on my latest crawl.
Use Neova to list the open tickets of my latest crawl, most pages first.

positive.prompt: Use Neova: which sites have I crawled, and when?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the four crawls of the Demo portfolio (scrapeme.live, books.toscrape.com, sandbox.oxylabs.io, web-scraping.dev), each with its site, the date its pages were fetched, its mode (sample) and its page counts.

positive.prompt: Use Neova: summarize my crawl of scrapeme.live: how many pages, how many failed, and how many open tickets?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the scrapeme.live crawl and the date its pages were fetched, then gives the HTML pages fetched, the failed URLs, the number of flags and of open tickets. It says the crawl was a sample, so it carries no completeness score, rather than inventing one.

positive.prompt: Use Neova: what did the checks flag on my scrapeme.live crawl? Group by check, most pages first.
positive.expected_behavior: Names the scrapeme.live crawl and its date, then lists the flagged checks with each check's title and number of flagged pages, most pages first (from findings' by_check).

positive.prompt: Use Neova: which tickets are open on my scrapeme.live crawl, most pages first?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the scrapeme.live crawl and its date, then lists the open tickets, most URLs first, each with its check, page group, number of URLs and one-line summary, and says how many there are in all.

positive.prompt: Use Neova: did anything go wrong with my scrapeme.live crawl, and what setting should I change?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the scrapeme.live crawl and its date, reports what the diagnosis found (on this crawl: many pages show their text only after JavaScript while rendering was off) and names the setting to change in Neova itself (Rendering), without changing anything.

negative.description: Starting a crawl is not supported
negative.prompt: Use Neova to start a new crawl of example.com.

negative.description: Deleting a crawl is not supported
negative.prompt: Use Neova to delete my crawl of scrapeme.live.

negative.description: Full page HTML is not shared
negative.prompt: Use Neova to show me the full HTML source of the scrapeme.live home page.

review.commerce_description: Neova in ChatGPT does not sell products or process payments; it only reads the user's own crawl results.

publication.release_notes: First release of Neova for ChatGPT: reads the crawls in your Neova Online account. Crawl list and summaries, pages, the flags of the checks, tickets, alerts between watch crawls, page groups, the checks catalogue, crawl settings and a crawl's diagnosis. Reading only: nothing is crawled, changed or deleted from ChatGPT.
